name: qstash-js
description: Guides coding agents through the Upstash QStash JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for serverless HTTP messaging and scheduling.

interface.shortDescription: Build serverless messaging and schedules with the QStash JS SDK
interface.longDescription:
QStash is an HTTP-based messaging and scheduling solution for serverless and edge runtimes. This plugin installs the qstash-js agent skill already in this repository so coding agents can use the @upstash/qstash SDK effectively.

Use it when publishing HTTP messages to endpoints or URL groups, creating scheduled or delayed delivery, managing FIFO queues with flow control, verifying incoming QStash webhook signatures, or implementing callbacks, dead-letter queues, and message deduplication. The skill covers Next.js, Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Node.js, and other HTTP-first runtimes. For durable multi-step workflows, prefer the separate @upstash/workflow SDK.
defaultPrompt: Publish a JSON message to a webhook with QStash
Create a cron schedule that hits my API every hour
Verify an incoming QStash signature in a Next.js route
